iPad11,3.reason: DeviceKit explicitly marks both iPad Air 3 identifiers as having no rounded display corners, agreeing with BezelKit's zero radius. Apple specifications confirm the 1668 x 2224 Retina display and product identity; they do not publish a numeric corner radius.

iPhone13,2.reason: The installed Apple display profile and its DeviceCornerRadius field both specify 47 logical points. Retain this traceable display reference instead of replacing it with BezelKit's runtime-derived 47.33; neither value is claimed to be a physical measurement.

iPhone13,3.reason: The installed Apple display profile and its DeviceCornerRadius field both specify 47 logical points. Retain the Apple reference; the separate BezelKit runtime-derived value is preserved in the audit.

iPhone13,4.reason: The installed Apple display profile and its DeviceCornerRadius field both specify 53 logical points. Retain the Apple reference; the separate BezelKit runtime-derived value is preserved in the audit.

iPad16,8.reason: DeviceKit groups iPad16,8 and iPad16,9 as iPad Air 11-inch (M4). Apple's iPad16,9 profile supplies the 18 / 820 geometry. Reject BezelKit's first-generation iPad Pro name and zero radius for iPad16,8.
